questions.text: Выбери верную форму: Look! My little brother ___ with our cat.
questions.explanation: Look! — действие происходит сейчас, Present Continuous: is playing.

questions.text: Выбери верную форму: My pen friend Sam ___ three languages.
questions.explanation: Знание языков — постоянный факт, Present Simple. Sam — он (he), поэтому speaks.

questions.text: В каких предложениях время выбрано верно? (выбери все верные варианты)

options.text: We often write emails to each other.
Listen! Somebody is knocking at the door.
She is going to school every day.
Look! The children play in the snow.

questions.explanation: Often — привычка (Present Simple), Listen! — сейчас (Present Continuous). Every day требует Present Simple (goes), а Look! — Present Continuous (are playing).
Ребёнок спит прямо сейчас — Present Continuous: is sleeping.
Never — привычка, Present Simple. My dad — он (he), поэтому drinks.

questions.text: Впиши форму глагола: At the moment we ___ (sit) in a café.
questions.explanation: At the moment — сейчас, Present Continuous: are + sitting (t удваивается).

questions.text: Впиши форму глагола: Tom ___ (watch) cartoons on Sundays.
questions.explanation: On Sundays — регулярное действие, Present Simple. Tom — он (he), после ch добавляем -es: watches.

pairs.left: I am sending you a photo now.
She is reading a comic now.

questions.explanation: Present Simple — привычка, обычное действие; Present Continuous (am/is/are + -ing) — то, что происходит сейчас.

questions.text: In summer we usually ___ to the countryside.
questions.explanation: Usually — привычка, Present Simple. С we глагол без -s: go.
